completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.

reading_notes: All 175 actual native Isaiah 1-8 units were read in exact order before curation. The original full-text source-reading gate and its hash are embedded in the current-run reading log; source references match the frozen plan. Isaiah 2:22 is absent in this source and was not invented.

All actual retained targets and necessary context were read this run. The context list contains 161 actual ranges; the reading log contains 909 distinct actual units, including the complete source cohort. Prior-run packets supplied schema examples only, never new review evidence.

All 170 complete source/target/relationship/rationale triples were reread in four complete batches. Ten source references received precision refinements; all twelve triples belonging to those references were then reread, including the two unchanged additional-target triples. All 15 deferrals, three complete unretained candidate cases, and seven unavailable-target hint decisions were reread. Independent peer precision edits at 3:14, 3:16 and 3:17 were applied; all three complete final amended triples were reread, with source and target texts, before refreshing this receipt. No targets or counts changed.

The 170 distinct retained pairs cover 160 sources. Each range is one pair. Ten additional targets address a distinct facet, historical counterpart, or explicit scriptural application; none receives separate credit merely for another verse within the same retained range. Fifteen source-only deferrals, three read-unretained candidates, and seven unread Revelation hints earn zero completion credit.

The all-targets-read flag applies to retained targets; unavailable Revelation hints expressly have target_passage_read false and source_and_target_read false. No target wording or supported relationship is asserted for them. The pinned Revelation record is unavailable, as freshly checked by the technical helper.

Native wording controls every comparison, including the Lord's high eyes in 2:11, admonition to bind the righteous in 3:10, mourning adornment-cases in 3:26, the glory statement in 4:2, no holy-seed clause in 6:13, the great/drunken razor in 7:20, and law sealed against learning in 8:16. Historical and New Testament comparisons retain differences in agency, place, audience, outcome, and citation form.

No repository file was modified. This is an initial curated review of the supplied English edition; specialist original-language and live-anchor checks remain distinct from this reading. Independent peer acceptance is recorded separately.
